title: Chief Minister Employment Generation Programme (CMEGP) Maharashtra
department: Directorate of Industries, Government of Maharashtra
source: Directorate of Industries, Government of Maharashtra (maha-cmegp.gov.in)
eligibility: Resident of Maharashtra state with valid domicile certificate.
Age: 18 to 45 years (relaxation up to 50 years for SC/ST/Women/Ex-servicemen).
Educational qualification: Minimum 7th standard pass for projects over ₹10 Lakhs (8th pass for > ₹25 Lakhs).
Only for new micro business units or greenfield projects.
documents: Caste / Category Certificate (if claiming special subsidy rate)
Gram Panchayat / Local Body No-Objection Certificate (NOC)
Bank Account Details and Machinery Quotations
summary_mr: CMEGP अंतर्गत महाराष्ट्रातील ग्रामीण भागातील नवीन सूक्ष्म उद्योगांसाठी १५% ते ३५% भांडवली अनुदान (जास्तीत जास्त १२.५ लाख रुपये) दिले जाते. यासाठी वयोमर्यादा १८ ते ४५ वर्षे असून किमान ७ वी उत्तीर्ण असणे आवश्यक आहे.
summary_hi: CMEGP योजना महाराष्ट्र के ग्रामीण और अर्ध-शहरी क्षेत्रों में नए सूक्ष्म उद्यमों के लिए 15% से 35% तक (अधिकतम ₹12.5 लाख) पूंजीगत अनुदान प्रदान करती है।
summary_en: CMEGP provides 15% to 35% capital subsidy (up to ₹12.5 Lakhs) for new micro-enterprises in Maharashtra. Requires Maharashtra domicile, age 18-45 years, and minimum 7th standard pass for projects over ₹10 Lakhs.

title: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
department: Khadi and Village Industries Commission (KVIC) & Ministry of MSME
source: Khadi and Village Industries Commission (KVIC) & Ministry of MSME (kviconline.gov.in)
eligibility: Any individual above 18 years of age.
At least VIII standard pass for projects costing above ₹10 Lakhs in manufacturing sector.
Self Help Groups (SHGs) and institutions registered under Societies Registration Act.
No existing assistance received under any other subsidy-linked central scheme.
documents: Project Report with machinery cost breakdown
Rural Area Certificate issued by Gram Panchayat / Block Development Officer
summary_mr: PMEGP अंतर्गत ग्रामीण भागातील विशेष प्रवर्गासाठी ३५% आणि सर्वसाधारण प्रवर्गासाठी २५% क्रेडिट-लिंक्ड भांडवली अनुदान (जास्तीत जास्त १७.५ लाख रुपये) मिळते. उत्पादनासाठी कमाल प्रकल्प मर्यादा ५० लाख रुपये आहे.
summary_hi: PMEGP के तहत ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों में विनिर्माण हेतु ₹50 लाख और सेवा क्षेत्र हेतु ₹20 लाख तक का ऋण मिलता है, जिसमें 25% से 35% तक की सब्सिडी मिलती है।
summary_en: PMEGP is a credit-linked subsidy programme offering 25% to 35% capital subsidy (max ₹17.5 Lakhs) for manufacturing units up to ₹50 Lakhs and service units up to ₹20 Lakhs.

title: PM Formalisation of Micro food processing Enterprises Scheme (PMFME)
eligibility: Individual micro food processing units, SHGs, and Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs).
Units adhering to One District One Product (ODOP) focus products receive priority.
Applicant must be above 18 years and hold premises ownership or lease.
Willingness to formalize enterprise and obtain FSSAI license.
documents: Proof of food processing activity (electricity bill, trade license, FSSAI if existing)
Machinery purchase quotations from verified suppliers
Detailed project estimate for technology upgrade
summary_mr: PMFME अंतर्गत अन्न प्रक्रिया उद्योगांना (उदा. हळद, मसाला, पिठाची गिरणी, डेअरी प्रक्रिया) ३५% भांडवली अनुदान (जास्तीत जास्त १० लाख रुपये) मिळते. एक जिल्हा एक उत्पादन (ODOP) अंतर्गत प्राधान्य दिले जाते.
summary_hi: PMFME योजना खाद्य प्रसंस्करण इकाइयों को 35% क्रेडिट-लिंक्ड सब्सिडी (अधिकतम ₹10 लाख) प्रदान करती है। एफएसएसएआई (FSSAI) पंजीकरण और उद्यम औपचारिकीकरण में भी सहायता मिलती है।
summary_en: PMFME provides a 35% credit-linked capital subsidy up to ₹10 Lakhs for micro food processing enterprises (e.g., turmeric, spices, dairy processing, flour mills) with ODOP priority.

title: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)
department: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
source: MUDRA Ltd. & Department of Financial Services (mudra.org.in)
ownContribution: Nil for Shishu (up to ₹50k); 10-15% for Kishore/Tarun
eligibility: Non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises.
Shishu: Loans up to ₹50,000 for initial startup needs.
Kishore: Loans from ₹50,000 to ₹5,00,000 for equipment purchase/expansion.
Tarun: Loans from ₹5,00,000 to ₹10,00,000 (and up to ₹20 Lakhs for Tarun Plus).
Clean credit record with no institutional default.
documents: Identity Proof (Aadhaar / Voter ID / Driving License)
Address Proof (Gram Panchayat certificate / Electricity bill)
Quotations of machinery / inventory to be purchased
Proof of business registration / Udyam Certificate
summary_mr: मुद्रा (MUDRA) योजनेतून कोणत्याही तारण (collateral) शिवाय शिशु (₹५० हजारांपर्यंत), किशोर (₹५० हजार ते ५ लाख) आणि तरुण (₹५ लाख ते १० लाख) अंतर्गत व्यवसाय कर्ज राष्ट्रीयकृत व सहकारी बँकांमार्फत मिळते.
summary_hi: प्रधानमंत्री मुद्रा योजना (PMMY) के तहत बिना गारंटी के ₹50,000 (शिशु), ₹5 लाख (किशोर) और ₹10-20 लाख (तरुण) तक का संस्थागत ऋण उपलब्ध कराया जाता है।
summary_en: PMMY provides collateral-free institutional credit across Shishu (up to ₹50k), Kishore (₹50k-₹5L), and Tarun (₹5L-₹20L) tiers through public, regional, and cooperative banks.

title: Maharashtra Agribusiness & Rural Transformation Project (SMART)
department: Department of Agriculture, Government of Maharashtra
source: Department of Agriculture, Government of Maharashtra (smart-mh.org)
eligibility: Community Based Organizations (CBOs), Farmer Producer Companies (FPCs), Primary Agriculture Co-op Societies (PACS).
Individual entrepreneurs partnering with registered farmer clusters in Maharashtra.
Priority for pulses, cotton, soybean, turmeric, fruits, vegetables, or goat rearing value chains.
documents: Audited financial statements (last 2 years if existing)
Board resolution and active farmer member list
summary_mr: महाराष्ट्र शासनाचा स्मार्ट (SMART) प्रकल्प कृषी मूल्य साखळी, ग्रेडिंग, पॅकिंग, कोल्ड स्टोरेज आणि प्रक्रिया केंद्रांसाठी ६०% पर्यंत (कमाल ६० लाख रुपये) अनुदान शेतकरी उत्पादक कंपन्यांना (FPO) देतो.
summary_hi: स्मार्ट (SMART) परियोजना महाराष्ट्र में कृषि मूल्य संवर्धन और पोस्ट-हार्वेस्ट अधोसंरचना के लिए 60% तक अनुदान प्रदान करती है।
summary_en: World Bank-supported SMART project provides up to 60% capital grant (max ₹60 Lakhs) for agricultural value-chain infrastructure and Farmer Producer Companies in Maharashtra.

title: Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises (CGTMSE)
eligibility: New and existing Micro and Small Enterprises in manufacturing and services.
Loans up to ₹5 Crore sanctioned by Member Lending Institutions (Scheduled Banks, RRBs).
Women entrepreneurs and units in aspirational districts receive up to 85% guarantee cover.
documents: Income tax returns & GST registration (where applicable)
summary_mr: CGTMSE योजनेमुळे ग्रामीण उद्योजकांना कोणतीही वैयक्तिक शेती किंवा घराचे तारण न देता बँकांकडून ₹५ कोटींपर्यंत कर्ज मिळण्यास ७५% ते ८५% केंद्र शासनाची हमी मिळते.
summary_hi: CGTMSE योजना के तहत बैंक बिना किसी तीसरे पक्ष की जमानत (Collateral) के एमएसएमई को ₹5 करोड़ तक का ऋण 75-85% गारंटी कवर के साथ स्वीकृत करते हैं।
summary_en: CGTMSE enables collateral-free bank loans up to ₹5 Crore by providing 75% to 85% credit guarantee cover backed by Ministry of MSME and SIDBI.

title: Official MSME Loan Documentation Guidelines for Rural Maharashtra
source: State Level Bankers' Committee (SLBC) Maharashtra & DIC
eligibility: Any rural entrepreneur applying for bank credit in Maharashtra.
documents: 7/12 extract and 8-A holding extract (if agricultural land is involved)
Gram Panchayat No-Objection Certificate (NOC) for commercial activity
Quotation of machinery from GST-registered suppliers
Detailed Project Report (DPR) showing cost of project and means of finance
Electricity connection sanction letter / water feasibility proof
summary_mr: ग्रामीण भागातील बँकेत कर्ज अर्जासाठी आधार, पॅन, ७/१२ व ८-अ उतारा, ग्रामपंचायत नाहरकत दाखला (NOC), मोफत उद्यम नोंदणी (Udyam), यंत्रसामग्रीचे जीएसटी कोटेशन आणि प्रकल्प अहवाल (DPR) आवश्यक असतात.
summary_hi: बैंक ऋण आवेदन के लिए आधार, पैन, भूमि दस्तावेज (7/12), ग्राम पंचायत एनओसी, उद्यम पंजीकरण, मशीनरी कोटेशन और विस्तृत प्रोजेक्ट रिपोर्ट (DPR) आवश्यक हैं।
summary_en: Standard rural bank credit appraisal requires Aadhaar, PAN, land 7/12 & 8-A extracts, Gram Panchayat NOC, free Udyam registration, machinery quotations with GST, and DPR.

title: Financial Literacy & Capital Structuring for Rural Enterprises
department: National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD)
source: NABARD Rural Financial Advisory & MSME Policy
eligibility: All Micro & Small Rural Entrepreneurs
summary_mr: व्यवसायासाठी भांडवल नियोजन करताना स्वतःचे योगदान (Own Contribution) १०-२०% ठेवावे, खेळते भांडवल (Working Capital) ३ महिन्यांच्या खर्चासाठी राखून ठेवावे आणि मासिक ईएमआय (EMI) अपेक्षित नफ्याच्या ५०% पेक्षा कमी असावा.
summary_hi: वित्तीय प्रबंधन में कार्यशील पूंजी (Working Capital) कम से कम 3 महीने के खर्च के बराबर रखें और मासिक ईएमआई अपेक्षित लाभ के 50% से अधिक न होने दें।
summary_en: Financial feasibility guidelines suggest maintaining at least 3 months of operational cash runway and keeping monthly EMI commitments below 50% of projected net cash operating surplus.
